integrity: The reduction direction, the finite-obstruction upper bound for non-tiling, the Berger halting lower bound, and recursive enumerability of the named systems were checked separately before combining them.
scientific_limitations: This is an exact-complexity sharpening extracted from a published undecidability reduction, not a new tiling encoding.

title: Exact halting-level complexity across Knudstorp's relevant-logic interval
